Solara — (9.6) INTERGALACTIC SUPERNOVA

SOUND OF SILENCE

"Sound of silence"

[Verse 1]

Level 50

The army

Everyone left behind

Everyone waiting

Then Cala stopped

“I hear something”

“What kind of something”

“The kind that comes before something that is not good”

Cygnus danced

(small, one movement)

(it meant: I hear you)

Cala smiled

[Pre-Chorus]

Thresh moved toward the door

Thresh arrived at the far east

“I need parameters”

“That is not the door”

“I am aware”

“Then why—”

“I need parameters”

Lorn: “She’s right. Something is—”

“You agree?” said Cala

“Yes — also your hair is perfect today”

“…thank you”

“The texture especially”

“LORN”

[Chorus]

Sound of silence

Rangor: “Are noises good?”

Sound of silence

Castor: “Do you hear anything?”

Sound of silence

Vael: “Am I loud?”

All three to the gate

Nothing

Just silence

Just the gate

Just—

[Verse 2]

Then the light

A wall of it

Cassie — stopped walking

Lara — dropped lower

Both of them inside the light

Perfectly still

Everyone: still

The army: still

The beasts: still

Then the ground moved

Something large

Something that should not be here

Because there is no water

[The Reveal]

“THERE IS NO WATER”

“That is—”

“It has—”

“FEET”

“Why does it have feet”

“THEY ARE FEET”

“HOW MANY”

“…a lot”

The Colossal Depthsquid

Stood on Level 50

On its many feet

In its complete absence of water

And looked at everyone

[Bridge]

The army held

Barely

Draco’s fighters — the left legs

Hydra’s wizards — right side

Rangor’s beasts — everywhere

It was not going well

It was going fine

It was not going fine

Then Aevum walked to the front

She looked at the Depthsquid

It looked at her

“…this again”

[Something ancient moved]

[Something old]

[And sent it back]

[Without hurry]

[Final Chorus]

Sound of silence

It is gone

Aevum already walking back

“What was that”

“Something old”

“What did you do”

“I sent it back”

“How”

“This again”

“That’s not an answer”

“It is the only answer”

[Outro]

Thresh: [arriving from the far east]

“The parameters were unclear”

“We know Thresh”

“Is it over”

“Yes”

“What was the parameter for victory”

“…we’re alive”

“That is acceptable”

Rangor counted his beasts

They were all there

He looked surprised

(he was always surprised)

Lorn: “Your hair held up remarkably well”

Cala: “Thank you Lorn”

[then the gate, Level 51]
